SCOPE OF WORK FOR PROVIDING SHEDS FOR BFP MOTOR
1. Removal of existing damaged shed and shifting to PPCL scrap yard.
2. Supply of required2" inch GI pipe, 1.5 X 1.5 square tube, GI sheets, consumables.
. 3. Necessary fabrication of frame work for shed which includes necessary cutting,
welding and fixing in position.
4. The contractor should deploy essential manpower and should complete the work in
single sitting.
5. Necessary welding machine, cutting set, cutting machine, other tools & tackles.
Consumables, paints and safet5r equipments are under contractor's scope.
6. The sheds to be provided is to have wheel arrangements so that it can be moved
during maintenance works.
7. Applying one coat of metal primer and two coat of smoke grey paint.
8. After completion the contactor should make the place neat and cleaning etc. as
directed by the Engineer-in-charge.
9. The party may visit the site before submitting the offer.
